bugs.creator: kevinushey
bugs.summary: Enable constant folding of paste / paste0?

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
Created attachment 3644
Add paste, paste0 to compiler:::foldFuns.

A somewhat common pattern in R packages / R code is to use `paste()` and `paste0()` to construct larger strings from literals. For example:

```
  regex <- paste0(
    "^(?<leading_dots>[.]{0,2})",
    "(?<numbers>[0-9]*)",
    "(?<leftovers>[^0-9]?.*$)"
  )
```

Could these functions be constant folded / evaluated at compile-time during byte code compilation? If I understand correctly, they could be added to the `compiler:::foldFuns` list, and the existing infrastructure would handle it correctly out-of-the-box.

```
Index: src/library/compiler/R/cmp.R
===================================================================
--- src/library/compiler/R/cmp.R	(revision 89685)
+++ src/library/compiler/R/cmp.R	(working copy)
@@ -502,7 +502,7 @@
 foldFuns <- c("+", "-", "*", "/", "^", "(",
               ">", ">=", "==", "!=", "<", "<=", "||", "&&", "!",
               "|", "&", "%%",
-              "c", "rep", ":",
+              "c", "rep", ":", "paste", "paste0",
               "abs", "acos", "acosh", "asin", "asinh", "atan", "atan2",
               "atanh", "ceiling", "choose", "cos", "cosh", "exp", "expm1",
               "floor", "gamma", "lbeta", "lchoose", "lgamma", "log", "log10",
```
